options.title: One {fact1} Video Built Dollar Shave Club
options.first_line: Dollar Shave Club started with one video that cost about {fact1}.
options.first_frame: A razor cartridge locked behind glass on a drugstore shelf, a label slamming in: Dollar Shave Club.

options.title: Dollar Shave Club Made One Video. Its Site Crashed
options.first_line: Dollar Shave Club made one cheap video, and its website crashed the same day.
options.first_frame: A man's hand reaching for razor blades locked in a drugstore case, the words DOLLAR SHAVE CLUB stamped over it.

options.title: Razors Were Locked Behind Glass. Dollar Shave Club Mailed Them
options.first_line: Drugstores lock razor blades behind glass. Dollar Shave Club mailed them to your door instead.
options.first_frame: Razor cartridges in a locked plastic case at a drugstore, a padlock in focus, a label: Dollar Shave Club.

why: A tiny figure for one video against a whole company makes a stranger ask how that is possible, and the answer (what the video did and what the company became) is held back until the end.
